analysis: All four units are documentation-only changes (docs/architecture/hardware-support.md, docs/architecture/inference.md); no executable code, config or wire contract changes are supplied, so no direct security regression is observable. Items examined for threat-model relevance: (1) inference.md patch around head lines 684-691 documents a cached verified weight hash (GLM5NextManagedLoad.verifiedArtifactSHA256, VerifiedWeightHashStore) that skips WeightHasher passes at the next coordinator-mode start while a file's device/inode/size/mtime/ctime are unchanged. This touches T-012/T-027/TB-003 (operator weight substitution; weight hash reported to the coordinator). The doc states the load re-verifies every file against the manifest before serving, but the cached hash is registered before that re-verification. An operator who can alter file contents while preserving inode, size and mtime (and ctime can't be forged without clock manipulation/root) could register a stale hash. The implementation is not supplied, so I record this as an unverified contract for the code PR review rather than a finding. (2) Video handling now accepts variable-frame-rate tracks, indexed at i / nominalFrameRate, instead of a deterministic 400. This is a behavior change in media parsing, bounded by the documented decoded-frame cap (512 MiB) and the pixel caps, and relevant to T-050 (media plaintext). No new plaintext persistence is described. (3) Documented GLM output-control changes: native-tracked engines refuse token constraints and unsupported topLogprobs as a 400 client_error before any reservation. This reduces the risk of breaker-striking 500s (availability, T-010), and the post-validation of forced tool_choice/response_format withholds output until validated. (4) hardware-support.md: documents the GLM wired-memory limit and the systemAvailable formula. There are no admission changes, and the doc states no cap change. Nothing here alters the A-001, A-003 or T-041 cache posture. Remaining integration question: confirm in code that VerifiedWeightHashStore binds to the full file identity plus the manifest aggregate, and that the coordinator-visible weight hash cannot be spoofed by pre-load staleness.
